summary: Practise role profiling, structured interviews and retention planning in a five-day talent acquisition training course. Explore the course outline.
lede: Talent acquisition training helps recruiters, HR practitioners and hiring managers turn vacancy needs into consistent selection and early-retention practices. You’ll practise creating competency-based role profiles, mapping sourcing channels, interpreting funnel measures, and using STAR interviews and scorecards through hiring scenarios and short calculations. The course also covers onboarding checkpoints and retention indicators, with introductory coverage of digital applicant-tracking workflows and ISO 30414 as a human-capital reporting reference.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people who define vacancies, attract candidates, assess evidence or act on early employee retention. It suits foundation-level learners who need a consistent approach across recruitment decisions and handoffs.
prerequisites: No prior talent acquisition qualification is required. Familiarity with hiring or HR responsibilities is useful; no coding or software installation is required.
